scripts.dev: pnpm --filter server db:sync && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "wait-on -t 60000 http-get://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health && pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.start: NODE_ENV=production sh -c "pnpm --filter server db:migrate && pnpm --filter server start"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter server typecheck
